fields.Name: W1 -> S9.4
fields.Description: Gate G0.4 (owner PR 2, phase 0, dataset W1, criterion S9.4): every row of the W1-signal s42 record-process scoring (NA, 2024) whose top per-record driver is Auto Renew shows the direction its own Auto Renew value pushes the risk. Drivers are measured from the mean training row, so an auto-renewing member's Auto Renew driver lowers the displayed risk (AtRiskRules.DriverRaisesRisk is false, the green "Lowers Risk" badge) and a member without auto-renew has it raise the risk. The seeded scoring has exactly 717 such rows (329 auto-renewing, 388 not), and all 717 must follow their own value (717 of 717).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: 717 of 717 Auto Renew top-driver rows show their own Auto Renew direction (329 auto-renewing rows "Lowers Risk", 388 others "Raises Risk").
